## Description {#details}

<p>Superclass for all disassemblers.</p>


<p>Consumes a memory region and provides an array of assembly instructions.</p>


<p>Definition at line 84 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/mc/include/llvm/mc/mcdisassembler/mcdisassembler-h">MCDisassembler.h</a>.</p>

### DecodeStatus {#a8eb822283e8f3200ca4b2a1ba0174e6a}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Ternary decode status.</p>

<dl class="doxyEnumList">
<dt class="doxyEnumTableTitle">Enumeration values</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyEnumTable">

<tr class="doxyEnumItem">
<td class="doxyEnumItemName">Fail<a id="a8eb822283e8f3200ca4b2a1ba0174e6aa537a26dac8694f2000c729a35e2ead30"></a></td>
<td class="doxyEnumItemDescription"> (= 0)</td>
</tr>

<tr class="doxyEnumItem">
<td class="doxyEnumItemName">SoftFail<a id="a8eb822283e8f3200ca4b2a1ba0174e6aa9d693b8e530a7fa3457dece6f8951e6c"></a></td>
<td class="doxyEnumItemDescription"> (= 1)</td>
</tr>

<tr class="doxyEnumItem">
<td class="doxyEnumItemName">Success<a id="a8eb822283e8f3200ca4b2a1ba0174e6aaabe09036b442fff9aa63ce1e844fdf60"></a></td>
<td class="doxyEnumItemDescription"> (= 3)</td>
</tr>

</table>
</dd>
</dl>


<p>Most backends will just use Fail and Success, however some have a concept of an instruction with understandable semantics but which is architecturally incorrect. An example of this is <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/arm">ARM</a> UNPREDICTABLE instructions which are disassemblable but cause undefined behaviour.</p>


<p>Because it makes sense to disassemble these instructions, there is a "soft fail" failure mode that indicates the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mcinst">MCInst</a>&amp; is valid but architecturally incorrect.</p>


<p>The enum numbers are deliberately chosen such that reduction from Success-&gt;SoftFail -&gt;Fail can be done with a simple bitwise-AND:</p>


<p>LEFT &amp; TOP = | Success Unpredictable Fail -----------—+--------------------------------— Success | Success Unpredictable Fail Unpredictable | Unpredictable Unpredictable Fail Fail | Fail Fail Fail</p>


<p>An easy way of encoding this is as 0b11, 0b01, 0b00 for Success, SoftFail, Fail respectively.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Used to perform separate target specific disassembly for a particular symbol.</p>


<p>May parse any prelude that precedes instructions after the start of a symbol, or the entire symbol. This is used for example by <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/webassembly">WebAssembly</a> to decode preludes.</p>


<p>Base implementation returns false. So all targets by default decline to treat symbols separately.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">

</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">Size</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>- The number of bytes consumed.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">Address</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>- The address, in the memory space of region, of the first byte of the symbol.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">Bytes</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>- A reference to the actual bytes at the symbol location.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd>
<p>- True if this symbol triggered some target specific disassembly for this symbol. Size must be set with the number of bytes consumed.</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/error">Error</a> if this symbol triggered some target specific disassembly for this symbol, but an error was found with it. Size must be set with the number of bytes consumed.</li>
<li>False if the target doesn't want to handle the symbol separately. The value of Size is ignored in this case, and Err must not be set.</li>
</ul>
</dd>
</dl>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Suggest a distance to skip in a buffer of data to find the next place to look for the start of an instruction.</p>


<p>For example, if all instructions have a fixed alignment, this might advance to the next multiple of that alignment.</p>


<p>If not overridden, the default is 1.</p>

<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">Address</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>- The address, in the memory space of region, of the starting point (typically the first byte of something that did not decode as a valid instruction at all).</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">Bytes</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>- A reference to the actual bytes at Address. May be needed in order to determine the width of an unrecognized instruction (e.g. in Thumb this is a simple consistent criterion that doesn't require knowing the specific instruction). The caller can pass as much data as they have available, and the function is required to make a reasonable default choice if not enough data is available to make a better one.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>
